verdict.rationale: Trivy publishes documentation, so asking for llms.txt or agent-oriented docs is a fair question. Probes show no such docs: trivy.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 404, and the markdown docs variant also returns 404. The official MCP server (trivy-mcp) is a separate agent-integration capability, not agent-oriented documentation, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
